question: Should this descriptor guard be rebased onto current main's adapter contracts, or folded into a broader replacement branch?
rationale: The branch is draft, protected, and conflicting; the wrong conflict resolution can drop current runtime tool metadata and hook behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before any cleanup or landing path.

options.title: Rebase around current contracts
options.body: Apply the safe descriptor readers to current main and keep `hideFromChannelProgress`, `prepareArguments`, `executionMode`, structured replay trust, and before-hook preparation/finalization intact.

options.title: Fold into replacement work
options.body: Close or supersede this only after a clean replacement PR preserves this PR's optional-field fallback and required-field skip behavior on the current adapter body.

recommendation.title: Rebase around current contracts
recommendation.body: Apply the safe descriptor readers to current main and keep `hideFromChannelProgress`, `prepareArguments`, `executionMode`, structured replay trust, and before-hook preparation/finalization intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They own this PR and the related descriptor-hardening work, and are already assigned to the branch.
